title: Lisbon summit ends with eleven signatories
text: Eleven delegations signed the Lisbon maritime accord, and 11 ministers stayed for the follow-up talks on shipping lanes. The final text adds 4 new monitoring posts.

title: Budget passes with a 22-seat margin

title: Central bank holds the rate at 4 percent
text: The central bank kept its policy rate at 4 percent for a third meeting, citing 2 quarters of slowing inflation. Officials flagged 11 risks to the outlook.

title: Election turnout reaches 33 percent

title: Quake of magnitude 7 hits the coastal province

title: Museum opens a show of 144 prints
